text.title: 门边的盒子
text.situation:
玛雅带着叠好的围裙来到社区中心。桌上有一个小捐款箱，旁边是接受捐款的本地慈善机构的照片。该机构向家庭借出图书和设备。今天的募款只是开放日的一部分：大家也可以试上绘画课、结识邻居，以及参观摆着身体知识展品的房间。

欢迎参加社区开放日
上午活动：画室绘画、大厅展览。
居民协会组织了下午的讨论。
如果你愿意帮忙，请到前台询问。

玛雅：这个捐款箱是为中心募款的吗？
乔：不是，钱捐给这些照片里的慈善机构。
玛雅：那是谁安排的讨论？
乔：居民协会。社区里有几个人希望找个地方交流。

paragraphs.en: Maya arrived at the community centre carrying a folded apron. A small donation box stood on the desk, beside photographs of the local charity that would receive the money. The charity lent books and equipment to families. Today’s fundraising was only part of the open day: people could also try a drawing class, meet their neighbours and visit a room full of exhibits about the human body.

paragraphs.en:
Welcome to the community open day
Morning activities: drawing in the studio and exhibits in the hall.
The residents’ association has organised the afternoon discussion.
Please ask at the desk if you would like to help.

paragraphs.en:
Maya: Is the donation box for the centre?
Jo: No, the money goes to the charity in these photographs.
Maya: And who planned the discussion?
Jo: The residents’ association. Several people in the community wanted somewhere to talk.

acceptableAnswers: 居民协会为社区中的人组织了讨论。
